title: City Eyes Acupuncture, Hospital Health, & Equity
summary:
*   Considered adding acupuncture to the city's future health or development plans.
*   Reviewed Brackenridge Hospital's operational workplan and external audit, in response to a State Comptrollers Report.
*   Discussed Affirmative Action policies, specifically for the Water/Wastewater department, and received an update from the Minority/Women Business Enterprise (M/WBE) Advisory Committee.
